name: Performance Grapher for Stream Deck
headline: See What Your PC Did, Not Just What It's Doing Right Now
description:
Performance Grapher for Stream Deck helps Windows gamers see what happened after a stutter, FPS drop, frametime spike, or temperature jump. Track rolling FPS and hardware history directly on Stream Deck, with 1% low, 0.1% low, worst frametime, GPU and CPU temperatures, GPU load, CPU/RAM load, session duration, and threshold alerts.

Five Stream Deck-native actions keep every key readable: Performance Graph, Game FPS, Session Summary, Sensor / Metric, and Alert. Press graph keys to cycle 60-second, 5-minute, 15-minute, and whole-session history. Game sessions are process-aware, so completed summaries keep useful context after the moment passes.

Performance Grapher uses PresentMon for local frame-presentation timing and Libre Hardware Monitor for supported sensors. Windows CPU and RAM remain available when advanced sensors are unavailable. No separate paid sensor app, API key, account, cloud service, or screen scraping is required.

PresentMon may require Windows Performance Log Users membership or administrator rights. Some hardware sensors may require elevated access or compatible existing drivers. The plugin never silently installs a kernel driver. History is bounded and stored locally on your PC.

Requires Windows and Stream Deck 7.3 or newer. Sensor availability varies by hardware and driver support.

Part of the PackRat Ecosystem.
release_notes:
- Adds Performance Graph, Game FPS, Session Summary, Sensor / Metric, and Alert actions.
- Tracks rolling hardware history plus process-aware FPS, 1% low, 0.1% low, and worst frametime.
- Uses PresentMon and Libre Hardware Monitor locally with no HWiNFO subscription or API key.
- Bounds sampling, rendering, in-memory history, and persistence to keep monitoring overhead low.
